d.ko: Trials of Innocence is an indie courtroom detective  game. Step into the shoes of the main character, rookie lawyer Luna Ray, and navigate her journey through the legal world. Unravel a shocking conspiracy that changes the fate of many, including herself, and confront her inner choices.
d.en: Trials of Innocence is an indie courtroom detective  game. Step into the shoes of the main character, rookie lawyer Luna Ray, and navigate her journey through the legal world. Unravel a shocking conspiracy that changes the fate of many, including herself, and confront her inner choices.
d.zh: 《无罪之庭》是猫龙游戏开发的法庭推理类独立游戏。游戏将以一名新手女性律师雷冬雪为主要角色，讲述其在律师之路上探索与追寻改变了自己与众人命运的惊天阴谋并最终面对自己内心选择的故事。游戏拥有完全原创的百万字以上的剧本与凶案，通过大量笔墨塑造了两名律师，四名检察官，以及二十多名性格迥异的证人，为玩家带来一场曲折离奇的推理之旅。
